title: Pokémon TCG Relicanth Scarlet & Violet-Temporal Forces 084/162 Holo Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Fighting type Pokémon, Relicanth. With a rare Rarity and part of the Scarlet & Violet-Temporal Forces set, this card is a must-have for any serious collector. The card is a Basic Stage Pokémon with 100 HP and a Card Number of 084/162. 

This particular card is a Holo Rare finish, adding to its collectible value. It is perfect for fans of the Pokémon Trading Card Game who are looking to expand their collection with a unique and valuable card. Don't miss your chance to add this impressive card to your collection.
